q: The concept of a dominated splitting generalises hyperbolicity. A T-invariant splitting TM|_Λ = E ⊕ F is dominated if there exists C > 0, λ < 1 such that for all x and all unit vectors u ∈ Eₓ, v ∈ Fₓ:
opts: F is contracting and E is expanding
exp: Dominated splitting: ||DT^n|_E(x)|| · ||DT^{-n}|_F(T^nx)|| ≤ Cλ^n (equivalently, E is uniformly dominated by F). Dominated splittings are C¹-robust and persist under perturbations, unlike hyperbolicity which requires both expansion and contraction.
